title: elatostema frutescens var. novoguineense
intro: Elatostema frutescens var. novoguineense, commonly known as the 'New Guinea Elatostema', is a plant species within the family Urticaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Elatostema frutescens var. novoguineense include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
